# Apollo

> Apollo es un agente personal de escritorio open source: un cerebro de IA que corre como Cloudflare Worker en tu propia cuenta, con un cuerpo físico que descansa en tu escritorio. Le hablas desde el otro lado del escritorio y la respuesta vuelve en voz alta. Sin app, sin teclado.

Apollo tiene licencia MIT y es gratis. El cerebro se despliega con un comando a tu cuenta de Cloudflare; el cuerpo es un dispositivo con firmware abierto que flasheas tú. Lo construye Valentín Galfre (github.com/galfrevn).

## Capacidades

- Turnos de voz: respuestas habladas y breves, afinadas para un dispositivo en el escritorio
- Memoria: recuerda lo que le dices y lo trae de vuelta cuando importa (Vectorize)
- Recordatorios: temporizadores y agendas que suenan en el propio dispositivo
- Respuestas en vivo: investigación web condensada en una oración accionable
- Agente de código: delega trabajo real sobre repositorios a un motor aislado
- Tus herramientas: se conecta por MCP a los servicios que ya usas, administrados desde la consola

## English

> Apollo is an open source personal desk agent: an AI brain that runs as a Cloudflare Worker in your own account, paired with a physical body that sits on your desk. You speak to it across the desk and the answer comes back out loud. No app, no keyboard.

Apollo is MIT licensed and free. The brain deploys with one command to your own Cloudflare account; the body is a device with open firmware you flash yourself. It is built by Valentín Galfre (github.com/galfrevn).

Capabilities: voice turns tuned for a desk device, memory recalled by meaning (Vectorize), reminders that fire on the device itself, live answers condensed from web research, a sandboxed coding agent for repository work, and your own services connected over MCP.

- [English landing](https://heyapollo.dev/en)
- [Handbook](https://heyapollo.dev/docs)

## Handbook chapters

- [Purpose](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/purpose): What Apollo is and is not.
- [Concepts](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/concepts): Desk, turns, sessions, and tools.
- [Loop](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/loop): How a request becomes a spoken reply.
- [Protocol](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/protocol): The full wire contract between the device and the server.
- [Capabilities](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/capabilities): Every tool Apollo can reach, and when it asks first.
- [Setup](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/setup): From one command to a deployed, talking worker.
- [Console](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/console): Manage a deployment from the browser.
- [Skills](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/skills): Hand the manual to your coding agent.
- [Firmware](https://heyapollo.dev/docs/firmware): Build, flash, and point a body at your brain.
